structures.name: Nick 4-step (default)
structures.description: When brief has approved peer-relevant proof. Order: opener → who/proof (1–2 lines peer+number+time) → offer (X in Y or Z) → CTA (permission default; timed call A/B). Follow-up: one short human ping; new subject; point back to email 1 / restate give.
structures.creator: Nick

structures.name: Nick 3-step
structures.description: When thin / no niche proof; brevity A/B. Order: opener → offer → CTA. Sender identity in From + signature only (no who-proof body).
structures.creator: Nick

structures.name: Platten AIDA
structures.description: Optional when strong named proof; Attention→Interest→Desire→Action. Desire must include X in Y or Z (not case-study-only). Slots: opener (often platten-hook), interest_mechanism, proof_block + cold_expression, CTA.
structures.creator: Platten

structures.name: Connor 3-paragraph
structures.description: Optional enterprise/title×industry. Order: who I am → why (priorities/challenges + how you solve, weave X-in-Y-or-Z) → what I want (assumptive time ask). Assumptive calendar language allowed only on this structure. Not default for AU SMB owners.
structures.creator: Connor

openers.label: Mode: nick-tier (default)
openers.body: Clear the scammer check — who is this / do I know them? Buys ~30s of read. Must not signal selling. Tiers: 0 Segment (one line true of shared list field + light variation) · 1 Cold read (~80% ICP-true, unfalsifiable, casual) · 2 AI-woven (human frame + one scraped fact in a slot) · 3 Bespoke (hand research, ~50-lead high-value). Rules: 1 sentence ideal / 2 max · true facts only · casualize entities · no city-only mail-merge as woven · no Beaver Corp fluff.
openers.creator: Nick
openers.notes: Default mode. Ops: /enrich-first-line (+ Origami skip when list already has opener/subject).

openers.label: Nick tier 0 — Segment
openers.body: [One line true of a shared list field + light variation]
openers.creator: Nick
openers.notes: When: thin data / big lists. Cheapest tier that works.

openers.label: Nick tier 1 — Cold read
openers.creator: Nick
openers.notes: Default when facts thin. No verbatim demo line in openers.md — shape only.

openers.label: Nick tier 2 — AI-woven
openers.body: [Human frame + one scraped fact slotted in]
openers.creator: Nick
openers.notes: When reliable fact exists. No city-only mail-merge as 'woven'.

templates.name: Charlie — custom AI coach (AFTER)
templates.email_body:
Hi Nick, huge work on the 290K month solo, man. School games, we're
lucky to have you. I build custom AI coaches for school communities. I
work with a few of the top 20 right now, collectively over 500k month in
rev, and train them specifically in your resources and unique voice.
Through this, we managed to save over 20 hours per week of coach time,
which I'm sure you can imagine stacks up quite a bit. I'm confident I
could save you a tremendous amount of time working on your school. Your
group is basically perfect for this, and there's undoubtedly a lot of
heavy lifting you're doing right now that I think you don't have to be.
I want to put my money where my mouth is. Will you let me build you a
high-quality AI coach in the next 7 days, 100% your tone of voice? If it
doesn't save you 5 hours per week or more, you wouldn't pay a cent. You
wouldn't have to do anything to get started other than just send me an
invite to your school. I'll handle all the rest in the background. Let
me know if this is worth your time. If so, could show you how it works
over a casual 15-minute video call — can ring you 10 a.m. today or
Thursday. Thanks man.
templates.creator: Nick Saraev Cold Email
templates.notes: Teardown #1 AFTER rewrite. Offer: free AI coach build in 7 days or don't pay if <5 hrs/wk saved.

Thanks, Grove.
templates.creator: Nick Saraev Cold Email

templates.name: ACC 4-touch sequence (bump/value/breakup)
templates.followup_body:
2. Quick Bump (2 days later):
Hey, I know you're busy, just making sure this email didn't get buried.
Hey, is there anyone else at {{companyName}} I should be sending this to?

3. Value (2 days later):
[Different angle or case study from your homework, a free audit offer, or a video.]

4. Break-Up / Something funny (3 days later):
At this point I'll assume (your offer) isn't a priority right now. Feel free to reach out when it changes.
templates.creator: ACC
templates.notes: ACC proven full shape = 4 emails. Cadence: bump 2d → value 2d → breakup 3d. Earn steps with performance (VID2).
